news.title: Argentina crowned world champions in Mexico
news.details: Argentina 3–2 West Germany in the final at Estadio Azteca, Mexico City, on 29 June 1986. West Germany finished as runners-up and France took third place.

news.title: The road to the final: semi-finals recap
news.details: France 0–2 West Germany · Argentina 2–0 Belgium.

news.title: 24 teams, 52 matches and 132 goals
news.details: The 1986 tournament produced an average of 2.54 goals per match. Argentina scored the most goals (14).

news.title: Biggest margin: Soviet Union vs Hungary
news.details: Soviet Union 6–0 Hungary (Group Stage, 2 June 1986) was the most lopsided result of the tournament.

news.title: 3 penalty shoot-outs decided the knockout rounds
news.details: Brazil 1–1 France (3–4 on penalties); West Germany 0–0 Mexico (4–1 on penalties); Spain 1–1 Belgium (4–5 on penalties).

news.title: West Germany crowned world champions in Italy

news.details: Republic of Ireland 0–0 Romania (5–4 on penalties); Argentina 0–0 Yugoslavia (3–2 on penalties); Argentina 1–1 Italy (4–3 on penalties); West Germany 1–1 England (4–3 on penalties).
